introduction: Rhode Island LIHEAP helps eligible households meet heating costs. Local community action agencies guide applicants through intake.
description: Rhode Island LIHEAP helps eligible households meet heating costs. Local community action agencies guide applicants through intake.

sections.who: The agency checks household income and heating circumstances against the current season’s rules. Confirm the current eligibility checklist locally.
sections.get: Assistance supplements heating costs and may include a separate crisis assessment. The agency determines the approved support.
sections.docs:
• Household and income records.
  • Heating bills or fuel supplier details.
  • Any shutoff notice or urgent lack of fuel.
sections.apply:
1. Find local intake

    Use the community action links on DHS LIHEAP.

  2. Confirm the season

    Ask about current appointments, required documents and available assistance.

  3. Explain an emergency

    Give the exact shutoff or fuel deadline and ask about crisis assessment.
sections.after: Keep your submission record and contact the supplier about arrangements. Assistance is not confirmed until the agency decides.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DHS LIHEAP; DHS heating programs. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Community action agencies provide intake guidance.
Will it pay every heating bill?
It is supplemental help, subject to program rules and funding.
What if I have no fuel?
Tell intake immediately and ask about emergency assistance.
Should I use an old income table?
Ask for the current season’s rules.
